verdicts.title: On Regularity of Max-CSPs and Min-CSPs
verdicts.abstract_excerpt: We study approximability of regular constraint satisfaction problems, i.e., CSPs where each variable in an instance has the same number of occurrences. verdicts.title: Statistical properties of superflares on solar-type stars based on 1-min cadence data
verdicts.abstract_excerpt: We searched for superflares on solar-type stars using Kepler data with 1 min sampling in order to detect superflares with short duration. We found 187 superflares on 23 solar-type stars whose bolometric energy ranges from the order of $10^{32}$ erg to $10^{36}$ erg.
